content.text: Guided group travelTurn your “maybe someday” into “let’s go” with just $99 down and easy monthly payments.† Your trip to Europe—whether wandering the Hagia Sophia, cruising the Douro River, or anything in between—is waiting for you on the other side of “yes.”Skip to page selector2026 Travel Flash SaleSave up to $500Spring has sprung, so what better time to let your travel dreams bloom? Shop by 4/21 to claim a deal on your 2026 tour.† What to know before you goCOUNTRIES ON TOUROur Europe tours take travelers from Portugal to Romania, and Norway to Italy. Crystalline beaches, lush alpine forests, ancient monuments, and bastions of culture: you’ll find all these and so much more. MAJOR CITIESAt first glance, Europe’s calling cards might be London, Paris, and Rome—timeless capitals are always in season. Take the path less traveled (think: Bratislava, Helsinki, and Valletta) to discover your unexpected new favorite place.CULTURAL QUICK TAKEThe three-cheek kiss in Provence, a rich espresso sipped al banco in Naples, the cascading laughter that can only come when the craic is flowing in Dublin—there are countless of small, if-you-know-you-know traditions for you to discover. WHAT TO GO FORThe ancient ruins of the Colosseum and the Parthenon. The whitewashed villages on Santorini. Art around every corner. The light fog rising off the Scottish Highlands. Gelato. Croissants. Pasteis de nata. It’s a feast for the senses, no matter which Europe tour you choose.UNIQUE EXPERIENCES ON TOURAn overnight stay in a castle? A train ride through the Swiss Alps? A pasta-making class in Rome? They’re all waiting for you on tour.See more in a single tripWhy limit your adventure to just one country? Our Multi-Country Tours invite you to explore Europe’s diverse cultures, landscapes, and histories—all in one unforgettable journey.Experience it all on the Grand Tour of EuropeSix countries. Ten cities. A once-in-a-lifetime journey. Meet and mingle with Europe’s best-loved landmarks and unexpected new favorites. Introducing EuropeThere’s a European destination that’s just right for you. Want to walk through living history? Head to Italy or Greece. Want to hold your breath? Brave the cliffside scenery in Ireland or Iceland. We’ve planned the perfect itineraries so you can see the best (and the unexpected) in each country.Your trip to Europe begins hereYou could wait for inspiration to strike—or find some with a little help from our team of experts.
